title: A man attacks a politician in Australia

paragraphs: Independent Australian lawmaker Helen Haines remains in critical condition following a shocking vehicle attack outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, Victoria.

A 43-year-old suspect allegedly rammed his car into her while she was standing near the trunk of her vehicle, and then backed up to strike her again. A local barber disarmed and held the suspect until police arrived. Authorities have charged the suspect, while counterterrorism units and federal police assist with the investigation. The attack resulted in the amputation of one of the woman’s legs, and surgeons are working to save her other leg.

Haines is known for her political integrity and independent work representing regional interests, and she is widely respected across party lines. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called the event a deliberate act and warned against growing hostility and rhetoric directed at elected officials. The incident has raised deep concerns about security and the changing safety of public access to politicians in Australia.

paragraphs: An Australian politician named Helen Haines is fighting for her life after a driver deliberately hit her with a car outside her office. She suffered severe injuries, and doctors had to amputate her leg.

A brave local barber stopped the driver and took away a knife he had before police arrested him. Police charged a 43-year-old man in connection with the attack. Australian Prime Minister condemned the attack and asked leaders to stop angry political language across the country. People know Haines as a popular politician who works closely with her local community. This terrible event shocked Australians and raised serious worries about safety for politicians who normally meet people easily in public.
